text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... someone is calling for me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—I am Saint Red Desire. One destined to 
eventually reach "that promised land."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Though it may still be far, I shall surely 
reach it. Overcoming countless trials, I 
shall seize immense brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To a wondrous "other world"â!

Starting today, my days with the Umamusume 
I train, Red Desire, begin.

I set up a schedule and put together a 
training menu for the debut race, but...
choice_data_list: (...Are we really sure this is okay?)

text_block_list.text:
Now that the dream stage known as the 
Twinkle Series has become a reality—

My desire to achieve great milestones 
alongside Red Desire is growing ever 
stronger.

My chest was filled with anticipation... 
and with an even greater burden of 
pressure.
choice_data_list:
I shouldn't be dwelling on this, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over and support this saint 
who runs with all her might.

—I snapped out of it and checked the 
clock. It was almost time for training 
with Red Desire.

I couldn't afford to be late on the very 
first day. I hurried over to the grounds, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

Red Desire was already running alongside 
several Umamusume. Her fighting spirit was 
truly formidable—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Right here! Haaaaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then, next... Here goes one 
more!

text_block_list.name: Desire's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're running again...!? You're not 
supposed to do that many all-out reps!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Welcoming this bright, clear day 
makes me feel as though a holy power is 
welling up from within.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To elevate my spiritual rank, I must push 
this body even harder!"

text_block_list.name: Desire's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Still... didn't you just crash into the 
rail earlier? Look, your leg is bruised. 
That looks like it hurts...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern. But... 
something like this is nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because I am—the Saint!

text_block_list.name: Desire's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... ...Ah, ahh! Look, your Trainer's 
here!

text_block_list.name: Desire's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
You're starting training, right? I'll 
leave the rest to you. Please keep a close 
eye on her!
choice_data_list:
Ah, yeah...! Sorry to keep you waiting, 
Desire.

Y-Yeah...! Sorry to keep you waiting, 
Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Don't tell me you were watching 
the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: How was it—the Saint's running...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Kyaah!

"Her legs tangled and she fell, but she 
quickly got right back up."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Guh...! It is not a problem at all...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As a Saint, I cannot... let myself be 
stopped by something like this!"
choice_data_list:
Y-Your nose is bleeding! Let's get that 
treated!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. There is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot overcome a mere obstacle like 
this, how could I ever call myself the 
Holy Maiden Red Desire?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Bruises, scrapes, bloody noses— they are 
all proof that I faced the trials head-on 
to reach the other Sekai.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—To me, every single bit of it is an 
honor.

The strength of Red Desire's core is on 
another level. For she regards everything 
as a trial to reach the "Other World."

"Just what kind of alternate world is it 
that captivates her so much?"

"As your Trainer, I want to see it through 
together with you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Whatever hardships befall this body, they 
are all destiny. That is precisely why 
there is no trial that cannot be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I can overcome all trials. Because I 
am... the chosen Saint."
choice_data_list: (Those eyes... Yes, just like that time—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Have you ever considered yourself to be 
someone special?"

"I answered 'yes' that day. That soul of 
mine, quietly yet fiercely trembling at 
that moment—"
I hug her tightly once more.

I vow once more: I will understand the 
true meaning of the "Other World," and 
continue to support her as she strives to 
reach it.

"To completely believe in Saint Red 
Desire, and in myself who chose to believe 
in her."
choice_data_list: (So that we never waver going forward—!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, shall we begin our new 
trial? A saint has no time to stand 
still."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond the trials—overcoming them again, 
and again, and again— that is where true 
brilliance awaits!"

My vision had completely cleared. Now, I 
can behold the very same scenery as her.
choice_data_list: Shall we begin today's trial, then!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Aiming for the distant "Otherworld"—!

Training was finished, and I called out to 
Red Desire to suggest wrapping up for the 
day.
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! You mustn't!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, wait! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, to celebrate the start of our 
journey, let us hold the "Ritual of 
Beginning"!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a sacred ritual where the Saint 
and her attendant take a vow for the 
journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Only by sharing these sacred drops and 
uniting our hearts will light illuminate 
the path ahead of us...!"
choice_data_list:
(…I feel like I read something like this 
recently…?)

text_block_list.text:
Ever since forming a contract with Red 
Desire, I've been reading isekai 
reincarnation novels to build up my 
knowledge, hoping to view the future 
through the same lens as her.
choice_data_list:
(In that case, maybe that would make her 
happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer? What's in the fridge...?
choice_data_list: Let's make a toast with this!

text_block_list.text:
Tada! I pull out a chilled bottle of grape 
juice to show her.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, could that be...! The Holy Crimson 
Drop?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You prepared the most fitting beverage 
for the 'Ritual of Beginning'... Ah... How 
marvelous, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, let us raise our glasses.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Upon the journey of Saint Red Desire and 
my wise—resonator of souls."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And, toward the beloved "other-world" I 
will someday reach—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It's just like that scene in 
the novel. From "The Galloping Saintess 
Reincarnated in Another World"...

"Yes. In the novel—the devotees were 
enraptured by the pure, beautiful radiance 
the Saint radiated... and if I recall, 
they said something like this."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let there be brilliance...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Grape juice tastes even more 
delicious after a workout...♪

And so, the tale of the Saint and her 
attendant traveling through another world 
truly began—!
